scope: Read-only review of the supplement orchestration, non-inference qualification, archive/replay code, both complete synthetic-test sources, and shared helper contracts; no model requests, no session preparation, no source edits, no repeated tests.
findings: single_catalog requires exactly revised MG-R005 version 0.3.1, written, and full Suite fingerprint; prepare freezes one common request/message and sends it through the existing shared execution.run and cli_adapter for each model. The 20-case source snapshot is not confused with the single selected case.

Prerequisites pin the original freeze, verified original archive, completed score report and matching offline reconstruction. A root adoption gate precedes new session preparation; a distinct root release binds the new freeze and exactly two planned requests. Old answers, old session state and old mathematical attempts are not reused.

run_queue enforces original model/effort, unique fresh session ledgers, one sequential attempt per model, no automatic retry and stop after an operational failure. Missing request-count evidence stays null; zero is assigned only to a checked untouched second session.

supplement_preflight has no execute_session/model-generation call. Fresh CLI bytes/version and model inventory are checked; the exact authorized loopback proxy is reverified. Four original enabled/disabled capability controls are explicitly inherited with original raw-event, execution, verdict and identity bindings. They are not represented as four new probes.

The newly prepared mathematical sessions use fresh file-open/network probes; unchanged shared verify_release checks the frozen adapter/runner, suite, preflight and session-binding hashes. Wrapper scripts and archive/replay/preflight helpers are added to preflight bindings before release.

Supplement audit derives planned rows from freeze instead of the original 41/82 constants, checks sequential phases/unique starts, complete final row/index identities, distinct run IDs and shared audit_case evidence. Missing evidence remains an integrity issue rather than a successful zero count.

Archive uses explicit file inventories for runtime, session, frozen suite, preflight and raw inherited controls, plus a required extra-review manifest. It rejects symlinks, path traversal, sensitive-value patterns, nontext bindings and state/credential paths. The one settings binding uses a matching runtime copy rather than reading state.

Archive recomputes the comparison from current retained runs/reviews/receipts and requires normalized equality before copying. All copied bytes receive SHA256 in the manifest; the source is rechecked during copy. Both actual run reviews and explicitly enumerated raw primary/secondary/adjudication records are preserved.

Saved supplement_replay verifies the complete archive manifest and release/freeze binding, loads the archived shared comparison code under a separate module alias, checks its runner fingerprint, relocates run/receipt paths only in memory, blocks the old temporary root/processes/network, and compares summary/groups/paired/cases plus the full normalized report.

Read all 15 synthetic test definitions: 8 queue/selection/gate tests and 7 archive/replay tests. The archive integration test deletes its simulated source root before executing the saved replay script and checks archive bytes remain unchanged. Other tests cover stale scoring, tampered evidence, missing-count unknown, raw inherited control preservation and exclusion of state/symlinks. The author receipt reports 15 passes; this reviewer did not rerun them.
limits: This is source-level and synthetic-evidence review. Actual original 82-run archive/replay, final revised R005 adoption/author Lean validation, fresh identity/inventory/proxy/session probes, root release, two new answers and final supplement archive/replay have not been performed by this reviewer.

Qualification is explicitly inherited for search controls, not a new live check of backend tool behavior. Exact client/model/config identity and fresh session probes are the stated basis; final reporting must preserve that distinction.

The extra-review archive manifest is an operator-declared complete inventory. The tool validates listed bytes and retained final run judgments but cannot discover an omitted arbitrary external secondary review; root must list every actual review before archival.
The fixed original AGY binary is intentionally excluded from evidence archives and must be copied to the new private identity directory before the old temporary root is removed, as documented.
